component.name: Markdown Editor
component.summary: A powerful Markdown editor with real-time preview

description.p: Markdown Editor is a modern, feature-rich application for creating and editing Markdown documents. It provides a clean interface with real-time preview, multiple rendering styles, and comprehensive formatting tools.

ul.li: Real-time Markdown preview with multiple themes
Split-pane editing with synchronized scrolling
Comprehensive formatting toolbar
Search and replace functionality
Multiple preview styles including Slate, Ivory, Nocturne and Ember
Dark and light theme support
Multi-language support (English and Spanish)
Outline navigation, search and replace, session recovery and export

screenshot.caption: Main editor interface with split-pane view

description.p: Update 1.3.0: maintenance release with minor improvements and fixes
Update 1.2.0: editor workflow, preview and UI improvements

ul.li: Reworked project structure into a cleaner package layout
Added outline navigation, recent files, search and replace, and richer preview blocks
Added session recovery, autosave recovery, HTML/PDF export and editor preferences
Improved GNOME/libadwaita alignment in the main window and menus
Added new preview styles: Slate, Ivory, Nocturne and Ember
Fixed preview rendering issues with unclosed tags
Fixed window styling and titlebar handling for better Adwaita integration
Restored original icon set for view controls
Real-time Markdown preview
Multiple rendering themes
Internationalization support
Dark/light theme toggle
